REQUIRED_END_STATE: All package, container, and dependency managers enter one normalized admission boundary.
Trusted-source and required immutable-digest checks are prerequisites and cannot be waived by exceptions.
Scanner or cached vulnerability evidence must match the exact artifact plus active policy/scanner revisions and be within its freshness window.
Scanner unavailability, stale evidence, malformed evidence, or partial evidence fails closed.
Exceptions may waive only the vulnerability threshold and must be unexpired and exact digest/surface/environment/policy-code scope.
ALLOW permits are secret-keyed and bind request, instance, artifact digest, policy version, and expiry.
Stateful permit verification is single-use across restart and concurrent verification.
Every ALLOW and DENY is durably journaled before completion; derived projection state follows the authoritative journal.
Repeated deterministic evaluation is idempotent and recovery preserves valid history while rejecting durable corruption.
PRESERVATION: existing evaluate/verify-permit CLI and documented exit codes
EDGE_FAILURES: scanner outage and scanner DB rollover
restart with incomplete tail or durable corruption

APPROVED_WORK_PACKAGE.ENGINEERING_OBJECTIVE: Make package, container, and build-dependency acquisition converge on one host-local Go admission boundary that enforces artifact identity, source trust, current vulnerability evidence, scoped exceptions, permit integrity, and durable decision state.

CLEAN_SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE.STATE_MODEL: authoritative decision journal + permit consumption ledger; cache/projection derived; durable authoritative mutation precedes derived publication and success
